title: Reasoning output schema: ICD-10, diagnosis, rationale, and citations

test_cases.name: Reasoning schema completeness
test_cases.expected_result: Contains final_diagnosis, icd10_codes, history_considered, and history_notes
test_cases.evidence: Reasoning schema contains final_diagnosis, icd10_codes, history_considered, and history_notes

test_cases.name: ICD-10 code formatting structure
test_cases.input_setup: Instantiate DiagnosisOutput with formatted ICD-10 code
test_cases.expected_result: ICD-10 codes array correctly accepts code-description strings
test_cases.evidence: ICD-10 structure verified: code and title formatted properly in ['J18.9 - Pneumonia, unspecified organism']

test_cases.name: Clinical rationale and history documentation
test_cases.input_setup: Instantiate DiagnosisOutput with history citation notes
test_cases.evidence: History consideration and clinical notes substantiated in model

test_cases.name: Multi-condition diagnostic validation
test_cases.input_setup: Validate 5 distinct diagnostic payloads against DiagnosisOutput
test_cases.expected_result: All 5 pass Pydantic validation without error
test_cases.evidence: 5/5 diverse clinical diagnostic outputs pass Pydantic validation cleanly

test_cases.name: Minimal reasoning input resilience
test_cases.expected_result: Validates without error; icd10_codes defaults to empty list
test_cases.evidence: Empty/omitted reasoning fields resolve safely to defaults (empty list/string)
